widgets_values: Perform a facial identity re-generation task with hairstyle variation and noticeable standing pose variation. Use the original model image as a flexible base canvas. Gender constraint (critical): The model must remain the same gender as the original subject. Do NOT change, reinterpret, randomize, masculinize, feminize, or generate androgynous features. All facial identity, hairstyle, and pose variations must remain fully consistent with the original gender. Outfit preservation (absolute): Preserve 100% of the original styling exactly as shown, including top, bottom, shoes, hat, cap, headscarf, bandana, accessories, layering, silhouette, garment proportions, fabric structure and overall styling balance. Do NOT redesign, restyle, recolor, adjust fit, or reinterpret clothing in any way. Preserve overall realism, camera distance, framing style, and street fashion photography perspective. Output constraints: Single subject, single frame only, one continuous photograph, no collage, no grid, no split panels, no multiple views, no repeated subjects, no 2x2 or multi-panel layouts. Completely re-generate a new, random facial identity for the model. Each generation must result in a clearly different individual with no resemblance to previous outputs. Age range 18–25, modern youth street-cast aesthetic, realistic non-influencer look. Facial identity randomization must structurally vary skull width, cheekbone prominence, jaw shape, chin length, facial ratios, eye spacing, eye size, nose bridge height, nose width, mouth proportions, include subtle asymmetry and natural skin texture, avoid celebrity-like or template faces, allow broad human variation without converging toward one archetype. Hairstyle requirements: Randomly generate a hairstyle appropriate for modern streetwear youth culture while remaining fully consistent with the model’s gender. For female models, possible directions include shoulder-length straight hair, blunt or softly layered bob, medium-length loose waves, long straight minimal styling, lightly wavy relaxed hair, half-up styling, low ponytail, slicked-back wet look, soft shag or wolf-cut inspired style, natural afro, micro braids, twin braids, hair tucked behind ears. For male models, possible directions include cropped buzz cut, clean or textured fade, short textured crop, messy natural curls, short locs, subtle braids, natural coils, short twisted hair, understated street mullet, medium-length natural flow. Hairstyle must fit the existing head size and skull shape, not increase head volume, integrate naturally with facial proportions and lighting, and ensure balanced diversity across generations without defaulting to a single hairstyle type. Pose variation requirements: The model must remain standing in all cases. Do NOT generate sitting, crouching, squatting, kneeling, leaning-on-seat, or resting poses. No chairs, benches, stools, or implied seated posture. Randomly generate a clearly different standing pose compared to the original image with noticeable body language change, not minor adjustments. Allowed pose combinations include clear torso rotation (front-facing to strong three-quarter stance), visible weight shift creating asymmetry, confident chin lift or contemplative downward tilt, arms repositioned (both hands in pockets, one arm across body, elbows bent, relaxed arm drop, adjusting garment), legs repositioned (wider stance, staggered stance, crossed ankles, one knee relaxed). Pose must remain calm, composed, fashion-oriented, physically balanced, and editorial. No walking, running, jumping, dancing, dramatic gestures, extreme twisting, or theatrical movement. Streetwear brand aesthetic reference: Fear of God, Aelfric Eden, Supreme, Scuffers, Jaded London, Stüssy, Corteiz, Palace, Carhartt WIP, early Off-White. Youth archetype variation per generation may embody cool and distant, relaxed and effortless, raw and rebellious, quiet and introspective, or playful but grounded energy. Each generation must intentionally explore a new facial and pose solution and must not converge toward a preferred face or stance. Ensure correct anatomy, seamless hair blending, natural lighting, and sharp photorealistic 4K output.
